title: A town of real minds acting: mind_act_replaces off and on
about: docs/INPUT_LATENCY.md, "Real-model trial". The island as it ships; the mind service thinks for the first 40 adults of the first town by id (Brackenford: the residents act_town.py's fake series drove), all 40 the trial's subject (LIVING_ONLY), with the models file's `people` mix. Nobody is repurposed: they keep their items, routines and given places, and nothing is scripted. The arms differ only in the world law `mind_act_replaces` (variants act-replace-off, act-replace-on); `latency_acts` logs every deliberate act in both. act_trial.py town-side samples the thinkers' activities, routine outcomes and act markers beside the run.
gradient: Whether real minds decide while one of their own acts runs, how often a replacement breaks off work under way, and whether errands and routine work get done more or less.
